name: Cham Islands
provinceNote: Xã Tân Hiệp, Da Nang, the islands off Hoi An.
summary: Snorkel over coral in the Cu Lao Cham marine reserve, then eat seafood in Bai Lang. The islands sit off Hoi An, a morning boat from Cua Dai, with Hai Tang pagoda in the village and a homestay night after the day boats leave.
timeNeeded: A landing day, or a night in Bai Lang
fee: 70,000 VND per person per visit from 10 June 2026, collected for the nature reserve. City tourism list: 20,000 VND sanitation; ticket sales 07:00–16:00. The visit fee is waived on four Tết days, 29 March, 26 May, and 2 September. Boat fare: Check on arrival. Snorkel price: Check on arrival. A separate pagoda ticket: Check on arrival. Stall prices: Check on arrival. Yến sào grades yến quang, yến thiên, and yến bài, May 2026: nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram.
getThere: Boat from bến thủy nội địa Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm. Minutes and the fare: Check on arrival. Hải Tạng: about 20 km from the Hoi An shore (city temple page). Commune: 18 km from Hoi An (biodiversity agency). Crossing time: Check on arrival. 2020 reserve: seven islands — Hòn Lao, Hòn Cụ, Hòn Khô, Hòn Lá, Hòn Dài, Hòn Mồ, and Hòn Tai. 30 June 2026 city page: eight islands, and about 15 km² of land. Da Nang International (VVDN) is southwest of the city and 3.2 km from the city centre. Road minutes from the airport to the Cửa Đại pier: Check on arrival. No station on the island. Mainland rail stop for this crossing: Check on arrival. On 30 August 2023: passengers from 08:00, a crowd from 08:00 to 10:00, life jackets checked before a boat is cleared. No return clock on that report. Ride minutes between Bai Lang, Bai Huong, and Bai Ong: Check on arrival. 2020 zoning decision was replaced by Decision 63/2026. 2020 restoration water: Rạn Mành, part of Hòn Tai, Bãi Nần on Hòn Lao, Rạn Mè – Bãi Ông, and Hòn Dài. 2020 strict water: Hòn Tai, Bãi Tra on Hòn Lao, the north of Hòn Lao, Hòn Mồ, Hòn Lá, and Hòn Cụ with Hòn Khô. 2020 rule: tourism boats may not anchor on coral or seagrass. 5 Feb 2026 notice: snorkel with a permitted operator. Service-zone shores Bãi Xếp, Bãi Chồng, Bãi Bìm, Bãi Hương, and Hòn Dài water: swimming, snorkel swimming, scuba, and seabed walking, with a permit. Restoration water under tight control: Rạn Mè – Bãi Ông, Hòn Tai, Hòn Dài, Rạn Mành, and Bãi Nần, including snorkel swimming, scuba, SUP, kayak, and glass-bottom boats. Strict zone closed to swimming and snorkeling. Monument hours: Check on arrival.
bestMonths: Summer, holidays, and Tết crowd the pier
seoTitle: Cham Islands travel guide — snorkeling, the marine reserve, seafood
seoDescription: Snorkel with a permitted operator in the marine reserve, eat the catch in Bai Lang, and walk up to Hai Tang. The visit fee is separate from the boat.
intro: You snorkel over coral off Hòn Lao, the forested ridge, the houses on the shore, and the boats in the same view. Hòn Lao is the largest island and the only one with residents. A night here is a village house in Bai Lang after the day boats have gone back to Cửa Đại. Most visits are a day on the water, not a hotel night.

Snorkel with a permitted operator. Service-zone shores named for swimming and snorkel swimming include Bãi Xếp, Bãi Chồng, Bãi Bìm, and Bãi Hương, plus the named water at Hòn Dài. Restoration water under tight control includes Rạn Mè – Bãi Ông, Hòn Tai, Hòn Dài, Rạn Mành, and Bãi Nần. The strict zone is closed to snorkeling and swimming. Stay if the hamlet after the day boats leave is the trip. Go back to Hoi An if you wanted the old town, and do not put My Son on the same morning as the 08:00 pier.

Bai Lang is the landing. Hải Tạng stands in Xóm Cấm there, facing the fields called Đồng Chùa. It was built in 1758, about 200 metres northeast of today’s site, and moved in 1848 after storm damage. A 2002 repair, a lotus pond, and a 3.5 metre Quan Âm stand in front of the three-door gate. It is a national relic from 2006. Breakfast stalls line the Bai Lang coast road, and the evening meal sits around 17:00–18:00.
gettingAround: Fly into Da Nang International (VVDN), southwest of the city and 3.2 km from the city centre. The boat leaves from bến thủy nội địa Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm. Passengers move from 08:00, with the crowd from 08:00 to 10:00, and life jackets are checked before a boat is cleared. Land at Bai Lang. Hải Tạng, the founders’ hall, and the whale shrine are in that hamlet. The well and Âm Linh are in Bai Ong. The nest-trade temple is in Bai Huong. On the island, walk.

stayAreas.name: Bai Lang
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in a village house here if you want the shore after the day boats leave. Bai Huong and Bai Ong are the other hamlets on the same island. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: The daily plate is the catch: fish, shrimp, squid, and swimming crab, with rice and little spice. Breakfast stalls line the Bai Lang coast road and the area by the well. Lunch sits around 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal around 17:00–18:00. Mực một nắng is the squid dried one sun. Stone crab is a visitor catch, and only from 1 March to 31 July.
interestsBody: Dining is the coast-road breakfast and the catch. Squid dried one sun and the registered nest are what you carry home.
The morning is Hòn Lao from the boat: ridge, shore, and the boats.
Snorkel with a permitted operator in the named water. The strict zone is closed. Do not treat every bay as a swim.
Hải Tạng is the pagoda above Đồng Chùa. The well, the whale shrine, the founders’ hall, Âm Linh, and the nest temple are in the hamlets.

interestGroups.title: Hải Tạng Pagoda
interestGroups.summary: Walk to the pagoda above Đồng Chùa after you land in Bai Lang.
body: Hải Tạng faces Đồng Chùa. It was built in Cảnh Hưng 19 (1758), about 200 metres northeast of today’s site, and moved in Tự Đức 1 (1848). A 2002 repair, a lotus pond, and a 3.5 metre Quan Âm stand in front of the three-door gate. It is a national relic from 2006.
The same heritage list names the founders’ hall, the whale shrine, the Xóm Cấm well, the nest-trade temple, and Âm Linh. The pagoda serves the islanders and the trading ships that stopped to pray.

blocks.heading: The pagoda above Đồng Chùa
paragraphs: Walk through Bai Lang after you land. Read 1758 and 1848 as two dates: built, then moved after storm damage.
The island visit fee is 70,000 VND per person per visit from 10 June 2026. It is separate from the boat.

body: Yến sào Cù Lao Chàm – Hội An was registered on 23 November 2020. Harvests run from mid-April to early May and from mid-August to early September. Mực một nắng is tube squid dried one sun, sweet when it was dried the day it was caught.

blocks.heading: Nest and dried squid
paragraphs: Ask for the registered nest, yến sào Cù Lao Chàm. The grades yến quang, yến thiên, and yến bài were quoted in May 2026 from nearly 100 million to nearly 180 million VND a kilogram. That figure is the product, not a bowl.
Mực một nắng dries for one sun. The main seasons named for it are vụ Nam, June to September, and vụ Bắc, December to April.

faqs.q: Does the 70,000 VND visit fee include the boat?
faqs.a: No. The reserve visit is 70,000 VND per person per visit from 10 June 2026. A city tourism list also names 20,000 VND sanitation, with ticket sales 07:00–16:00. The boat is a separate charge. Snorkeling is with a permitted operator, and that add-on is separate too.

season.label: Check the pier
season.note: The pier crowd ties to summer, holidays, and Tết, with passengers from 08:00 and the crush from 08:00 to 10:00. No month is named for a pier closure. Cầu Ngư is a lunar rite at the whale shrine, not that crowd calendar. The visit fee is waived on four Tết days, 29 March, 26 May, and 2 September. The boat is still a separate charge.
